Off Calendar Dec-02-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Diana Padilla. Petitioner, Julie Todd was sworn and examined. Good cause appearing, the Court grants the Decree changing Petitioner's Name to Julianne Todd Ohtaki. Decree signed in open court.
